title: ACPolyp: active-contour-guided polyp classification study on Kvasir v2
description: A leakage-audited, shortcut-aware, statistically controlled study of whether an unsupervised active-contour prior improves deep classification of endoscopic findings on Kvasir v2, with calibrated and conformal inference and a local web app. Main finding: no statistically supported gain from contour guidance (null result). Research prototype, not a medical device. The Kvasir datasets are NOT included; they are licensed by Simula for research and education only.
notes: Source code, audited split id lists with SHA-256 hashes, paper and report sources. Model weights are not part of this record; see the Hugging Face repository.
